answer: System-liveness note (v4). A referral tree is a bridge: weight flows across it only where a real, established span carries load. A sybil adds planks of walnut that touch nothing — a terrace with no footing — so emission routes around them. PoA pays propagation and challenge work, both of which demand fresh labor per node, so a wide fake fanout earns exactly what one idle account earns: nothing.
